coverage_model: implemented=complete for the stated claim_scope; partial=bounded executable slice with unresolved requirements; context_required=no safe automatic verdict without stated missing context; not_implemented=no executable check

unresolved_requirements: Complete technical-term validity and all contextual dictionary-use decisions.
rules.claim_scope: Known dictionary/glossary membership, unapproved forms, ambiguity blockers, and unknown-term classification only.

unresolved_requirements: General sentence parsing and part-of-speech resolution outside bounded frames.
rules.claim_scope: Approved dictionary part-of-speech misuse in bounded noun/verb frames recognized by the syntax substrate.

unresolved_requirements: Automatic approved-sense disambiguation.
rules.claim_scope: Occurrences with explicit project dictionary-meaning evidence only.

unresolved_requirements: Complete verb-form semantics and grammar beyond implemented slices.
rules.claim_scope: Known dictionary verb forms plus bounded direct perfect-tense morphology.

unresolved_requirements: Contextual selection among approved alternatives.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation; contextual selection among approved alternatives is outside current executable scope.

unresolved_requirements: Automatic classification and validity of unknown technical nouns.
rules.claim_scope: Unknown prose terms are blocked for technical-term classification; validity requires project authority.

unresolved_requirements: Technical-noun grammatical-role resolution outside the strong imperative frame.
rules.claim_scope: Governed technical-noun misuse in the strong imperative verb frame only.

unresolved_requirements: Complete technical-noun governance and consistency semantics.
rules.claim_scope: Deprecated governed project technical terms only.

unresolved_requirements: First-use definition and subject-field appropriateness.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of first-use definition or subject-field appropriateness.

unresolved_requirements: Automatic international-versus-regional/slang/jargon classification.
rules.claim_scope: Occurrences with explicit project technical-noun-scope evidence only.

unresolved_requirements: Definition and contextual appropriateness of technical names.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of technical-name definition or contextual appropriateness.

unresolved_requirements: Technical-noun formation and length semantics.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of technical-noun formation or length semantics.

unresolved_requirements: Technical-verb grammatical-role resolution outside the determiner-led frame.
rules.claim_scope: Governed technical-verb misuse in a determiner-led nominal frame only.

unresolved_requirements: Automatic spelling classification and official-name recognition.
rules.claim_scope: Occurrences with explicit spelling evidence and official-technical-name exception only.

unresolved_requirements: Noun-phrase structure and article grammar.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of noun-phrase construction and article grammar.

unresolved_requirements: Reference and pronoun identity.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of pronoun/reference identity.

unresolved_requirements: Complete approved-verb use semantics.
rules.claim_scope: Known approved/unapproved verb lexemes and ambiguity only.

unresolved_requirements: Complete tense and verb-role grammar.
rules.claim_scope: Source-backed verb paradigms and bounded role evidence; not complete tense grammar.

unresolved_requirements: Participle adjective-versus-verb/passive distinction.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic distinction between participle-as-adjective and passive/verb use.

unresolved_requirements: Perfect constructions outside the direct auxiliary-plus-participle pattern and deeper ambiguity resolution.
rules.claim_scope: Direct HAVE/HAS/HAD plus an unambiguous approved past participle only.

unresolved_requirements: -ing grammatical-role analysis.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of -ing grammatical roles.

unresolved_requirements: Passive-versus-adjectival participle analysis.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic distinction between passive voice and adjectival participles.

unresolved_requirements: General action-word role resolution.
rules.claim_scope: Bounded action-word role and part-of-speech misuse only.

unresolved_requirements: Semantic sentence-boundary and document-structure cases not represented mechanically.
rules.claim_scope: Mechanical sentence units and word-limit counting only.

unresolved_requirements: Non-deterministic or context-sensitive contraction-like forms.
rules.claim_scope: Deterministic contraction forms only.

unresolved_requirements: Nested, mixed, wrapped, and sentence-versus-fragment list semantics.
rules.claim_scope: Simple same-indent vertical-list mechanics only.

unresolved_requirements: Sentence connection and discourse relationship.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of sentence connection and discourse relationship.

unresolved_requirements: Complete sentence grammar and subject semantics.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of complete sentence structure and subject semantics.

unresolved_requirements: Context-dependent one-word identities not supplied to the counter.
rules.claim_scope: Procedural 20-word limit using the current Issue 9 counting model.

unresolved_requirements: Imperative instruction semantics, action count, and instruction intent.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of imperative instruction semantics or one-action requirements.

unresolved_requirements: Imperative recognition outside the bounded source-backed base-form frame.
rules.claim_scope: Bounded sentence-initial approved base-form imperative structure only.

unresolved_requirements: Condition semantics beyond the leading IF/WHEN structural slice.
rules.claim_scope: Leading IF/WHEN condition position and comma structure only.

unresolved_requirements: Non-imperative requirements, limits, and instruction semantics inside notes.
rules.claim_scope: Note sentence length and sentence-initial imperative candidates only.

unresolved_requirements: Key-information ordering and discourse importance.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of key information ordering.

unresolved_requirements: Topic progression and discourse coherence.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of logical topic progression.

unresolved_requirements: Unannotated semantic one-word identities required by Rule 8.6.
rules.claim_scope: Descriptive 25-word limit using mechanical and explicit context count groups.

unresolved_requirements: Logical grouping of related information into paragraphs.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of logical information grouping into paragraphs.

unresolved_requirements: Automatic topic inference and topic progression.
rules.claim_scope: Multiple distinct topics only when project topic evidence is supplied.

unresolved_requirements: Paragraph identity in document formats that do not use blank-line prose boundaries.
rules.claim_scope: Sentence count in blank-line paragraphs with recognized simple-list exclusions.

unresolved_requirements: Hazard actor, risk, and safety classification semantics.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of safety actor, hazard, or risk-level semantics.

unresolved_requirements: Complete safety-action semantics and multi-action analysis.
rules.claim_scope: WARNING/CAUTION opening and bounded imperative action structure only.

unresolved_requirements: Consequence, explanation, and hazard-result semantics.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of safety-result explanation or consequence semantics.

unresolved_requirements: All other standard-English punctuation decisions.
rules.claim_scope: Semicolon prohibition and simple-list comma/semicolon endings only.

unresolved_requirements: Automatic semantic judgment of whether hyphenated words are directly related.
rules.claim_scope: Hyphen direct-relation judgment only when explicit project evidence is supplied.

unresolved_requirements: Automatic semantic classification of parenthetical use.
rules.claim_scope: Parenthesis-use category only when explicit project evidence is supplied.

unresolved_requirements: Complex or nested vertical-list boundary semantics.
rules.claim_scope: Colon/list boundary behavior in the current simple vertical-list word-count model.
Parenthetical text groups count as one word in the current text-level analyzer.

unresolved_requirements: Unannotated semantic titles, headings, placards, labels, abbreviations, and proper nouns.
rules.claim_scope: Mechanical one-word groups plus explicitly identified abbreviations, titles, headings, placards, labels, and proper nouns.
Hyphenated token groups count as one word in the current text-level analyzer.

unresolved_requirements: Document-wide terminology identity and consistency.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic evaluation of terminology consistency across a document.

unresolved_requirements: Sense disambiguation across occurrences.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic one-meaning-per-word decision without sense disambiguation.

unresolved_requirements: Phrasal-verb recognition when the phrase is not explicit in dictionary authority.
rules.claim_scope: Dictionary-explicit unapproved multiword or phrasal entries only.

unresolved_requirements: Coreference and noun-versus-pronoun replacement semantics.
rules.claim_scope: No automatic noun-repetition decision without reference/coreference semantics.
